description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Ancient Stone Idol, adding {C}{C}.
Ancient Stone Idol dies, triggering itself and Nim Deathmantle.
Resolve the Ancient Stone Idol trigger, creating a 6/12 Construct artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Construct, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Stone Idol from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
